name: Pokémon™ X: Update
description:
An update for Pokémon™ X is now available from Nintendo eShop.

All customers who own a copy of “Pokémon X” should download the update.

This will update the software to Version 1.5 with the following amendments:

- Various bugs have been fixed in order to provide a smoother gaming experience.

Please note that ”Pokémon™ Y” cannot be updated using this data and you have to download the update data for “Pokémon Y” separately.
disclaimer:
Update data for Nintendo 3DS title Pokémon X.

After the download, the icon for this data won't appear on the Nintendo 3DS HOME Menu. The data will instead appear in System Settings under Downloadable Data, so please don't delete it.

You may need to upgrade your current SD Card to a compatible SDHC Card or microSDHC Card with enough available space to download this software. Visit support.nintendo.com for information about storage options. Sold separately.
